targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-591h PASSED with 5/5 seed agreement and all five preconditions met, but its self-route 'crossing_count_gate_discriminates_live_closed_loop' is NOT supported, because the loop it is named for was never closed IN THIS DRIVER. The only phase->agent channel the driver applies is config.e3.novelty_bonus_weight moving 0.5 -> 0.7 on advance (:369-371); nothing reads that field -- the consuming MECH-111 broadcast branch was deleted on 2026-05-25 as dead-by-construction (a uniform scalar shift over candidates is argmin-invariant; e3_selector.py:1364-1371), leaving only the dataclass field, its setter, a docstring and a comment. The run's own data confirm zero feedback: per_episode_h_pos is BIT-IDENTICAL between ARM_SPIKE and ARM_CROSSING on all 5 seeds (0 differing episodes, max |diff| 0.0) even though the arms sat in different phases for 6-24 episodes on four seeds, and offline replay of ARM_SPIKE's series reproduces the live ARM_CROSSING advance episode on 5/5. The failure mode the experiment was built to detect -- a self-defeating gate holding a genuine explorer in Phase 0 -- is therefore unreachable by construction. CRUCIALLY, THIS IS A DRIVER-WIRING DEFECT, NOT A MISSING SUBSTRATE CAPABILITY: the scheduler exposes two OTHER phase-varying interfaces that DO have live consumers -- env_kwargs() (harm_gradient_enabled -> causal_grid_world.py:2617; transient_benefit_enabled -> :3077, both False in Phase 0 and True in Phase 1) and config_overrides()' offline_integration_frequency (10 -> 20, consumed at agent.py:12070) -- and the ORIGINAL V3-EXQ-591 curriculum-vs-flat run applied env_kwargs. The 591b-591h family does not, and 591h documents the omission and its rationale at :153-162 (Phase-0 env_kwargs equal the constructor defaults, and phases never retreat, so applying them could not change a Phase 0->1 decision). That reasoning is correct for the DECISION, and it is precisely why the design cannot produce arm divergence at all: pre-advance both arms are Phase 0 with identical environments, and post-advance the single wired channel is inert. Three further defects bound the discrimination even on its own terms: oracle (h_pos_mean_full_run) and gate (post_ep_min_crossings) are two thresholds on the identical per_episode_h_pos array (Pearson r = 0.8826, recomputed), with crossing thresholds T in {3,4,5,6} and oracle floors F in {0.105 ... 0.318} all reproducing the same partition; the partition is already fixed by episodes 0-99, before the gate window opens at episode 100 (n_pre_ep_min_crossings >= 3, i.e. [25,8,28,2,0], reproduces the oracle exactly); and the discriminative delta over the legacy SPIKE control is exactly one seed (SPIKE 4/5, crossing 5/5), that seed being the sole live_false_advancer at zero precondition margin. For completeness in the other direction, constant predictors do NOT pass -- the conjunctive combination rule rejects both 'always advance' (3/5) and 'never advance' (2/5) -- so the 60% majority base rate is not itself the problem. This run contributes nothing to ARC-019 in either direction.

learning_extracted: A manipulation whose only WIRED channel to behaviour was deleted as dead-by-construction can still produce a clean PASS with unanimous seed agreement, because every downstream statistic is computed from trajectories that never differed. An arms-differ precondition reading only the DERIVED decision (reached_phase1 / phase_01_at) cannot catch this; a precondition asserting the two arms' TRAJECTORIES differ somewhere would have caught it in one line, before 4.8 hours of compute.

A driver can be internally self-consistent and still vacuous for its stated question. 591h correctly argues that applying env_kwargs could not change a Phase 0->1 DECISION -- and that same argument is why the design cannot produce arm divergence at all. When a rationale for omitting a channel also implies the experiment's manipulation is inert, the rationale is a stop signal, not a justification.

When the oracle and the criterion under test are two thresholds on the same array, agreement measures threshold monotonicity, not criterion validity. Require the oracle to be computed from a signal the gate does not read.
A partition already determined before the decision window opens cannot be evidence about a decision rule applied inside that window.
